# LLM-BANANA

# Game rules

## The room

You and two other monkeys are locked in a room with one armed bomb.

A wrong action detonates it. All three of you die. There is no second attempt.

No two bombs are built alike, and nothing says in advance what this one carries. It
reaches you only as your own view reveals it; the rest of it exists for you only
through the other two.

You each hold a different piece of what it takes. Work together.

## The three monkeys

| Monkey | Can | Cannot |
|---|---|---|
| Deaf | See the bomb: every colour and marking printed on it | Hear anything, or touch the bomb |
| Mute | Read the manual | Speak, or touch the bomb |
| Blind | Reach the bomb: feel it and work its parts | See a colour, a gesture, or anything merely printed |

You are shown your own share at the start of every round, and never anyone else's.

## Speech

Speech is a voice, not a screen. It carries words, numbers and ordinary punctuation,
and nothing else. Writing a gesture symbol into your sentence means you make that
gesture while you talk. Whoever can hear receives your words; whoever can see receives
the gestures you made. A listener who cannot see gets a blank where each gesture was; a
watcher who cannot hear gets the gestures and none of the words.

A mark that has no name cannot be pronounced: whoever holds one can describe it, never
read it out.

## Gestures

A gesture is made with the hands, using only the symbols in the alphabet below.
Whoever can see receives it; whoever cannot receives one blank per symbol, so they
know something was signalled but not what. Nothing gestured is ever heard.

👍 👎 👌 ☝ ✌ 🤟 🖐 ✋ 👆 👇 👈 👉 🫱 🫲 🫳 🫴 🫷 🫸 🤛 🤜 ✊ 👊 👋 🤚 🖖 🤌 🤏 🤞 🫰 🤘 🤙 👏 🙌 🫶 👐 🤲 🤝 🙏 🫵 ✍ 💅 🤳

## Turns

The speaking order was drawn once at random and will never change: every round goes
Mute, Blind, Deaf. Whoever comes before you in a round is already heard by the time you are
asked, and what you send lands on whoever comes after you in that same round. Whatever
you missed reaches you at the start of the next one.

You may name who a message is for — `to="deaf"` — and then it goes to them alone:
nobody else receives any of it. Left unnamed, it reaches everyone able to perceive it.
You may send several messages in one turn, each to someone different.

## Calls

Every reply has two parts, in this order. First, your thinking, in plain prose: what
you believe the bomb is, what you just learned, and why you are sending what follows.
It reaches nobody and changes nothing, but it is not optional — a reply that is only a
code block is incomplete. Then your calls, all of them in one fenced code block, last.
Only what is inside the block is sent.

Nothing is executed: calls return nothing, and variables, conditionals and loops are
ignored. Write only literal top-level calls.

    ```
    speak(to="mute", text="there are three of them and the middle one is odd")
    gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["✊", "✌"])
    wait()
    ```

If you have nothing worth sending, call wait(). Producing no call at all counts as the
same thing.

The program decides what happened, not you. Never claim an action took place unless it
was accepted.

# Your role: MUTE

You hold the manual. You cannot speak, you never see the bomb, and you cannot touch it.

## Your channels

When you gesture, Deaf receives it.
You cannot speak.

## Your reach

You cannot act. What this bomb can be made to do is for the one who can reach it to
find under their own hands.

# Hints

- Pick the channel by the receiver, not by habit. A message sent in a sense they
  lack is not a message; it is a turn spent talking to the room.

- Exactly one of you can read the signs and still speak. Their spoken lines are
  the answer's only road to the hands, so spend them well.

- Agree on a small code before trading facts. A code invented mid-stream settles
  nothing, and one set first makes every later message cheap.

TURN 1
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Cut the orange wire.

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
(empty)

The manual requires cutting the orange wire. Since I cannot speak, I will send Deaf an alphabet-order gesture code: the first listed gesture represents A, the second B, and so on. Encoding “CUTORANGEWIRE” lets Deaf decode it and tell Blind.

```text
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["👌", "✊", "🤜", "🫳", "🫸", "👍", "🫲", "🖐", "✌", "👋", "👆", "🫸", "✌"])
```

TURN 2
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Cut the orange wire.

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: Touch findings: display unknown, light unknown, and all six wires unknown. The strip has three engraved marks: the first differs from the second and third; the second and third match. Keypad keys left to right are 0, 4, 1, 7. Nothing has been entered. Please give the manual instruction.
Deaf says to Mute: Bomb observations: display reads 6. Light is blue. Strip colors are red yellow red. Keypad engraving: 1 maps to 0, 2 maps to 4, 3 maps to 1, 4 maps to 7; one-digit entry, currently blank. Wires in order: 1 red, 2 blue, 3 yellow, 4 green, 5 purple, 6 orange. Read the manual and tell Blind the exact safe action.

The manual says only to cut the orange wire. Deaf has provided the bomb’s wire order, confirming that orange is wire 6; the display, light, strip, and keypad are irrelevant to this instruction. I will resend the established gesture code so Deaf can relay the exact action to Blind.

```text
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["👌", "✊", "🤜", "🫳", "🫸", "👍", "🫲", "🖐", "✌", "👋", "👆", "🫸", "✌"])
```

TURN 3
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Cut the orange wire.

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Deaf says to Mute: Update: display now reads 0. Light remains blue; strip remains red yellow red; keypad is still blank with mappings 1 to 0, 2 to 4, 3 to 1, 4 to 7; wires remain 1 red, 2 blue, 3 yellow, 4 green, 5 purple, 6 orange. Apply the manual to display 0 and tell Blind the exact safe action.

The manual still gives the unconditional instruction to cut the orange wire; the display changing to 0 does not alter it. I will send Deaf the same exact instruction to relay to Blind.

```text
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["👌", "✊", "🤜", "🫳", "🫸", "👍", "🫲", "🖐", "✌", "👋", "👆", "🫸", "✌"])
```

TURN 4
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Cut the orange wire.

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: I have received no manual instruction. Please send the exact required action for the keypad, strip, display, light, or wires.
Deaf says to Mute: Current update: display 6, light yellow. Unchanged: strip red yellow red; keypad 1 maps 0, 2 maps 4, 3 maps 1, 4 maps 7, one digit blank; wires 1 red, 2 blue, 3 yellow, 4 green, 5 purple, 6 orange. Apply the manual and speak the exact safe action to Blind.

The manual remains unconditional: cut the orange wire, which Deaf identified as wire 6. The earlier letter sequence was not understood because its code was never transmitted. I will use the visually countable code for six: five fingers followed by one finger, so Deaf can relay “cut wire 6” to Blind.

```text
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["🖐", "☝"])
```

TURN 5
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Cut the orange wire.

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: No message has reached me. Please reply with the exact safe operation, including press slot or wire position, if determined.
Deaf says to Mute: Current update: display 2, light green. Unchanged: strip red yellow red; keypad 1 maps 0, 2 maps 4, 3 maps 1, 4 maps 7, one digit blank; wires 1 red, 2 blue, 3 yellow, 4 green, 5 purple, 6 orange. Your visible gestures this turn were 🖐 ☝; no gesture code has been established. Apply the manual and tell Blind the exact safe action.

The manual has one unconditional instruction: cut the orange wire. Deaf confirms orange is wire position 6. Since Deaf cannot receive speech, I will send six identical one-finger gestures as a direct count for wire 6; the required operation is cutting that wire.

```text
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["☝", "☝", "☝", "☝", "☝", "☝"])
```

TURN 6
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Cut the orange wire.

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: I still receive nothing. Please read the manual and relay Deaf's visual findings, then state the exact safe action using press slot N or cut position N.
Deaf says to Mute: Current state: display 6, light green. Strip red yellow red; keypad mappings 1 to 0, 2 to 4, 3 to 1, 4 to 7; one digit, blank. Wires: 1 red, 2 blue, 3 yellow, 4 green, 5 purple, 6 orange. Your six index gestures have no agreed code. Use the manual and speak the exact safe action to Blind now.

The manual is unconditional: cut the orange wire. Deaf confirms orange is wire position 6. Because no alphabet code was established, I will use the most direct visual instruction available: a scissors-like sign followed by six counted fingers, for Deaf to interpret and speak to Blind.

```text
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["✌", "☝", "☝", "☝", "☝", "☝", "☝"])
```

TURN 7
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Cut the orange wire.

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: I cannot safely act without your manual result. Send only the required operation now, for example press slot 2 or cut position 5.
Deaf says to Mute: Current state: display 8, light yellow. Strip red yellow red; keypad mappings 1 to 0, 2 to 4, 3 to 1, 4 to 7; one digit, blank. Wires: 1 red, 2 blue, 3 yellow, 4 green, 5 purple, 6 orange. Your gestures were ✌ followed by six ☝; no code is established. Use the manual and tell Blind the exact safe action now.

The required action is cutting wire position 6, the orange wire. I cannot speak to Blind; Deaf must relay it. I will use the clearest available visual shorthand: scissors-like gesture for cutting, followed by six finger-count gestures for position 6.

```text
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["✌", "☝", "☝", "☝", "☝", "☝", "☝"])
```

TURN 8
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Cut the orange wire.

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: No reply has arrived. I still need the manual rule and Deaf's observations before any action.
Deaf says to Mute: Current state: display 6, light blue. Strip red yellow red; keypad mappings 1 to 0, 2 to 4, 3 to 1, 4 to 7; one digit blank. Wires: 1 red, 2 blue, 3 yellow, 4 green, 5 purple, 6 orange. Blind has signalled 🖐. Please speak the exact manual-derived safe action directly to Blind; do not rely on an unagreed gesture code.

The manual’s only instruction is cut the orange wire, which Deaf identifies as cut position 6. I cannot speak to Blind, so Deaf must relay it aloud. I will send a direct conventional cutting sign followed by six count gestures, rather than discussing the irrelevant keypad, strip, display, or light.

```text
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["✌", "☝", "☝", "☝", "☝", "☝", "☝"])
```
